name: Financial Report
description: SDAO Financial Report (ICB-SDA-2026-007) required for the renewal of recognition: balances, sources of fund, summary of liquidation and signatories.
greeting:
Hi! Let's fill out the SDAO Financial Report for the renewal of recognition. Tell me the academic year, the opening balance, where the organization's money came from (membership fees, sponsors, fund-raising...) and what was spent on which events. You can also upload the treasurer's records, receipts or a spreadsheet.

You can also click any part of the document on the right to edit it directly.
ai_instructions: This is a financial statement: copy amounts, dates and names exactly as the user gives them and never estimate or invent any figure.
Write money as ₱12,000.00. The TOTAL rows are added up automatically, so do not add them as rows.
"sources_of_fund": one row per source of money (Source, Other Details such as the number of members or the sponsor, Amount).
"liquidation": one row per event or expense paid (Name of Event/Expenses, Date of Event/Payment, Amount). Use the liquidated events of this organization when the user mentions them.

"closing_balance": if the user does not give it but the opening balance, sources and expenses are all known, compute opening balance + total sources − total liquidation, and say in the reply that you computed it so the treasurer can check it.
"opening_balance_ay" is the academic year the opening balance belongs to; it is usually the same as "academic_year".

fields.label: Academic Year
fields.hint: Academic year covered by the report, e.g. 2025–2026.

fields.label: Opening Balance A.Y.
fields.hint: Academic year of the opening balance; defaults to the report's academic year.

fields.label: Opening Balance
fields.hint: Funds at the start of the academic year, e.g. ₱5,000.00.

fields.label: Closing Balance
fields.hint: Funds at the end: opening balance + total sources − total liquidation.

fields.label: Date of Submission
fields.hint: Date the report is submitted to SDAO.

fields.label: Sources of Fund
fields.hint: Each source of money: membership fees, sponsorships, fund-raising, school subsidy...

fields.label: Summary of Liquidation
fields.hint: Each event or expense paid during the year, with its date and amount.
